We support our customer’s system with the MRO activity, Our activity is based on the MRO, development of the IT to support applications, transformation of existing applications to the Cloud, Secure hybrid outsourcing or on premise infrastructure, and apply security audits on platforms and remediation’s plan.
 Job Summary
 As a Network Administrator and NetOps Engineer, your mission is to work on the delivery of new infrastructure. From the engineering to MRO, you will have to deploy new network infrastructure or transform them.
Your experience on Security infrastructure, Wan or Lan will allow you to challenge the design proposed before the build.
You are well aware of ITIL practice, so you will not put at risk the stability of our customer’s IT during the build and run and you should expect the role to be part of a global effort to support our customers on their IT. You should be someone who is passionate about automating, robustness and reliability, trouble-shooting network and system configuration, monitor and manage systems.
 Required competencies/experience:
Working knowledge of firewalling, WAN or LAN environment
Perfect knowledge of TCP protocol and packet analysis
Routing: BGP, OSPF
Switching: 802.1q, 802.1x, Spanning-tree, VTP, LACP, VPC, VXLAN, EVPN
Firewall, VPN, IPSEC,
Proxy, Load Balancing, IDS/IPS, DNS
Automation : scripts, Ansible, Python
ITIL v4
 Requested competencies / experience:
Firewalls : Juniper, ForcePoint, Palo Alto , Stormshield
Switch / router : Juniper, Cisco IOS end NXOS
Load balancer : F5
Proxy : Symantec (ex Bluecoat), McAfee
Tufin
SSL VPN : Pulse Secure
Fluent in French
 Behavioral skills:
 Strong team player
 Be autonomous and proactive on your tasks,
 Teamwork and knowledge sharing.

 Good communication skills
